Laboratory.cell: Arthur Holmes Isotope Geology Laboratory, Durham
Laboratory.value: Arthur Holmes Isotope Geology Laboratory, Durham

Target Material.cell: Os reference material solution — UMd, DTM, LOsST and DROsS

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Reference material solution aliquot — 200 ng/ml to 2.5 µg/ml Os, ~300 µl consumed per analysis

Sample Preparation Method.cell: N/A — reference material solutions, no solid preparation

Digestion Acid(s).cell: N/A — reference material solutions in 3 or 5 mol/l Teflon-distilled HCl

Digestion Step.cell: N/A - reference material solutions, no digestion.

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: Teflon-distilled 3 or 5 mol/l HCl — 200 ng/ml to 2.5 µg/ml Os

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: Up to 600 ng Os consumed per analysis; ~300 µl of solution
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: Up to 600 ng Os consumed per analysis; ~300 µl of solution

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Faraday Cup Array Configuration.cell: "The Durham Neptune has a 9 Faraday collector array equipped with 10^11 Ω resistor amplifiers which allow a maximum beam of 50 V per channel" (p.3). An SEM ion counter is also present — abundance sensitivity "was determined by scanning the low mass tail of a 30 V 192Os beam using the SEM" (p.3); its position is not stated
Faraday Cup Array Configuration.value: "The Durham Neptune has a 9 Faraday collector array equipped with 10^11 Ω resistor amplifiers which allow a maximum beam of 50 V per channel" (p.3). An SEM ion counter is also present

Faraday Cup Amplifier Resistor Values.cell: all: 10^11 Ω — a maximum beam of 50 V per channel

Faraday Cup Gain Calibration Method.cell: all: amplifier gains measured on peak with the line of sight valve closed at the start of each session, with the Virtual Amplifier in rotation mode to cancel them — §3.1

value.value: amplifier gains measured on peak with the line of sight valve closed at the start of each session, with the Virtual Amplifier in rotation mode to cancel them

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: Glass Expansion micro-cyclonic "Cinnabar" spray chamber; cooling not stated
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: Glass Expansion micro-cyclonic "Cinnabar" spray chamber; cooling not stated

Desolvation System.cell: all: none — desolvating nebulisers 'have been shown to suffer severe memory problems for Os' (§3.1)

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Microsoft Excel — "Following analysis all intensity data was exported and re-processed offline using Excel"

ICP Tuning.cell: "At the start of each analytical session the Neptune was tuned for maximum sensitivity and optimal peak shape using an Os solution, either the UMd or DTM RMs, and the mass calibration was updated by peak-centering on the centre-cup mass 187Os"
ICP Tuning.value: "At the start of each analytical session the Neptune was tuned for maximum sensitivity and optimal peak shape using an Os solution, either the UMd or DTM RMs, and the mass calibration was updated by peak-centering on the centre-cup mass 187Os"

Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.cell: "Instrument electronic baselines and amplifier gains were then measured ... while the Neptune was allowed to warm up for half an hour"
Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.value: "Instrument electronic baselines and amplifier gains were then measured ... while the Neptune was allowed to warm up for half an hour"

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 184Os, 186Os, 187Os, 188Os, 189Os, 190Os, 192Os → Os; 182W, 185Re → none — Table 2a; ¹⁸²W and ¹⁸⁵Re are the monitor isotopes

Baseline Measurement Approach.cell: Electronic baselines "measured, on peak with the line of sight valve closed"; peak centering and baselines "were not carried out at the start of each analysis to reduce measurement time and conserve sample but were repeated several times during an analytical session"
Baseline Measurement Approach.value: Electronic baselines "measured, on peak with the line of sight valve closed"; peak centering and baselines "were not carried out at the start of each analysis to reduce measurement time and conserve sample but were repeated several times during an analytical session"

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: "Teflon-distilled (TD) 3 or 5 mol/l HCl acid was aspirated between analyses until the 192Os beam decreased to acceptable background levels"; not required in single-RM sessions
Wash Time Between Samples.value: "Teflon-distilled (TD) 3 or 5 mol/l HCl acid was aspirated between analyses until the 192Os beam decreased to acceptable background levels"; not required in single-RM sessions

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Peak Flatness Method and Threshold.cell: Tuned for "optimal peak shape"; mass calibration updated by peak-centering on the centre-cup mass 187Os. No numeric threshold stated
Peak Flatness Method and Threshold.value: Tuned for "optimal peak shape"; mass calibration updated by peak-centering on the centre-cup mass 187Os. No numeric threshold stated

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Internal normalisation, applied offline in Excel with the abundance-sensitivity and W/Re corrections — §3.1, §3.5
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: Internal normalisation, applied offline in Excel with the abundance-sensitivity and W/Re corrections

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Abundance sensitivity (0.5–1 ppm, from the low-mass tail of a 30 V 192Os beam on the SEM) corrected offline — §3.1
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Abundance sensitivity (0.5–1 ppm, from the low-mass tail of a 30 V 192Os beam on the SEM) corrected offline

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes, W and Re on Os
Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.value: Yes, W and Re on Os

Interference Correction Method.cell: 184Os, 186Os: W subtracted from the 182W monitor with 182W/184W and 182W/186W interference ratios; 187Os: Re from the 185Re monitor with 185Re/187Re; other: N — ratios from doping experiments (§3.6.1, Table 3), e.g. ¹⁸⁵Re/¹⁸⁷Re = 0.598120

value.value: W subtracted from the 182W monitor with 182W/184W and 182W/186W interference ratios

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: Desolvating nebulisers deliberately avoided because of "severe memory problems for Os"; ESI PFA-50 low-uptake nebuliser and GE Cinnabar micro-cyclonic spray chamber chosen "in the hope these would reduce the long Os washout times and poor memory usually associated with solution introduction of Os"; wash acid aspirated until the 192Os beam fell to background — a 99.99% decrease reached after 220 s for DTM
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: Desolvating nebulisers deliberately avoided because of "severe memory problems for Os"; ESI PFA-50 low-uptake nebuliser and GE Cinnabar micro-cyclonic spray chamber chosen "in the hope these would reduce the long Os washout times and poor memory usually associated with solution introduction of Os"; wash acid aspirated until the 192Os beam fell to background

Uncertainty Level.cell: 2SD for short- and long-term reproducibility; within-run errors as "2 standard errors of the mean (2SE = 2SD/n^0.5; where n = 45 for the Neptune analyses"
Uncertainty Level.value: 2SD for short- and long-term reproducibility; within-run errors as "2 standard errors of the mean (2SE = 2SD/n^0.5; where n = 45 for the Neptune analyses"

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — n = 45 per analysis. No rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of the reference-material analyses in each session and over all sessions — Table 7a; 'Average Os ratios for the 94 UMd and 121 DTM RM analyses from all analytical sessions'

value.value: average of the reference-material analyses in each session and over all sessions

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — internal normalisation; the four Os RMs are the materials measured

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: UMd, DTM [all: 2SD of the analyses in each session] — Table 7a

value.value: 2SD of the analyses in each session

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: UMd [187Os/188Os: 0.113795 ± 25 (2SD, n = 94)]; DTM [187Os/188Os: 0.173923 ± 26 (2SD, n = 121)] — 9 sessions over 11 months (Table 7a)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: UMd [187Os/188Os: +26 ppm; 186Os/188Os: −125 ppm]; DTM [187Os/188Os: −12 ppm; 186Os/188Os: −108 ppm] — offset from Durham N-TIMS (Table 7a)
